data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'rosa', meaning 'rose'. Roses are often symbolic of love, beauty, and new beginnings. In Christian tradition, the rose is a symbol of the Virgin Mary and her purity. The name Rosette carries the meaning “Little rose” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rosette usually hope their child will grow to embody little rose and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rosette total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
